title: Regulation of Gene Expression and Metabolic Pathways in Yeast
summary: This cluster revolves around the regulation of gene expression and metabolic pathways in yeast. The JUB1 gene and its variant JUB1-X synTF play key roles in controlling the expression of GAL1 and inducing the production of IPTG. JUB1-X synTF also regulates the expression of ATPS, PPK2, and APSK. The cluster includes various yeast organisms, such as Borah Madhushruti's and Arenz Christoph's research subjects, Kluyveromyces lactis, and YPH500. The metabolic pathways involve the production of ATP, ADP, and PAPS, with enzymes like PPK, PPK2, and PPA. The cluster also includes various genes and proteins involved in transcription and translation, such as RNAP, LacI, and KanMX.
